description.en:
The WABA account ID, PageId, or AccountId<props="intl">, or ServiceId</props>.

- If ChannelType is set to WHATSAPP, specify the WABA account ID. You can view the WABA account ID on the Channel Management > Manage > WABA Management page.

- If ChannelType is not set to WHATSAPP, specify the PageId for MESSENGER, the AccountId for INSTAGRAM<props="intl">, or the ServiceId for VIBER</props>.

title.zh: 流程重新绑定号码或商家账号ID
title.en: Rebind a phone number or merchant account ID to a flow

descriptions.zh:
- 您可调用此接口给已绑定的流程重新绑定号码或商家账号ID，也可在[**流程编辑器**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)>**设置**界面手动重新绑定。

- 在调用此接口前，请确保您创建的流程已绑定号码或商家账号ID。

- 若您为首次给流程绑定号码或商家账号ID，可通过[FlowBindPhone](~~2937190~~)接口进行绑定。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to rebind a phone number or merchant account ID to a flow that already has a binding. You can also manually rebind on the [**Flow Builder**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) > **Settings** page.

- Before calling this operation, make sure that your flow already has a phone number or merchant account ID bound to it.

- If you are binding a phone number or merchant account ID to a flow for the first time, use the [FlowBindPhone](~~2937190~~) operation.
